build_torchvision_backend: build a TorchvisionBackend instance for GPU-accelerated batched image processing with configurable kwargs
build_pil_backend: build a PilBackend instance for portable CPU-only PIL/NumPy image processing
run_torchvision_resize: run TorchvisionBackend.resize on a torch.Tensor image with size, resample, and antialias parameters
run_torchvision_pad: run TorchvisionBackend.pad on a list of torch.Tensor images with pad_size, fill_value, and return_mask options
run_torchvision_preprocess: run TorchvisionBackend._preprocess to apply resize, center_crop, rescale, normalize, and pad pipeline on batched images
